annotations.text:
STATE 1 — Chat-first (from Concept 1)
Open-ended opener. One message extracts multiple facts at once; assistant recaps inline and asks one next thing — no fixed sequence. "What I know so far" stays a secondary expandable bar, never a form.

TRANSITION
Chat collapses into a small labeled "Chat" pill (chat-bubble icon, not a search icon — resolves the open concern from the Concept 2 review) while the comparison board builds beneath it.

STATE 2 — Comparison-first (from Concept 2)
All ~5 matches visible/comparable at once, not a carousel. Match/Price/Rating/Signals + a one-line rationale per row. "Chat" pill stays reachable, now secondary.

STATE 3 — Provider details
Sheet over the dimmed board. FACT vs INFERRED in separate labeled sections; INFERRED carries an explicit "not confirmed by the provider" caption.

STATE 4a — M10 loading
Same sheet. Copy states outright that the provider hasn't been contacted yet.

STATE 4b — M11 simulated answers
Every answer is tagged "SIMULATED · NOT CONFIRMED" plus a persistent banner spelling out no real contact happened — applied to availability, setup/policy, and price alike.

Error state
Inline, chat pill still reachable — nothing already gathered is lost.
